confidence_basis: Frontiers publisher HTML was reviewed after Consensus MCP returned an OAuth authorization error. The article directly reports the PPS measurement task stimulus type, 3000 ms duration, two near/far loudspeakers, DS7A electrical stimulation, right-hand electrode site, vocal response capture, 77% tactile-target trials, auditory-only catches, T1-T5 delays, one assessment block per measurement session, and the synchronous/asynchronous training context. The exact catch count is not printed, so the runnable profile derives 24 catches from the inherited Canzoneri-family 80-target measurement structure and the reported 77% target rate.

profile_recreation_assessment.reason: The paper reports enough minimum audiotactile measurement-task parameters for a parsimonious PPS Toolkit profile. The training intervention schedule is context, not a blocker for the runnable measurement block. Exact original pink-noise/gain assets, participant current calibration, and voice-key latency remain apparatus caveats rather than missing profile parameters.

orientation_ledger.participant_frame: Participants were seated beside a table with the right hand near the near loudspeaker.
orientation_ledger.room_apparatus_frame: Two hidden loudspeakers were mounted on the table: one about 5 cm from the right hand and the other about 100 cm from the near loudspeaker.
orientation_ledger.body_relative_mapping: IN sounds moved from far to near toward the participant/hand; OUT sounds moved from near to far away from the participant/hand.
orientation_ledger.tactile_anchor: Right hand, Neuroline/Ambu electrode pair controlled by a Digitimer DS7A constant-current stimulator.
orientation_ledger.movement_implementation: Physical two-speaker intensity manipulation for apparent moving pink noise; toolkit recreates this as a generated binaural trajectory proxy.
orientation_ledger.evidence_class: Frontiers publisher HTML methods/design text and Figure 6 caption.

Reviewed Materials/procedures lines for Measuring PPS representation, Figure 6 caption, Synchronous audio-tactile training, Asynchronous auditory training, Design, Results/Table 1/Figure 7, and Discussion.

stimulus_type.page_or_section: Materials and procedures, Measuring PPS representation
stimulus_type.evidence_note: The paper reports 3000 ms pink-noise auditory stimuli.

trajectory_path.value: IN sounds apparent far-to-near toward the subject; OUT sounds near-to-far receding from the subject.
trajectory_path.page_or_section: Materials and procedures and Figure 6 caption
trajectory_path.evidence_note: Two hidden loudspeakers were placed near the right hand and about 100 cm farther away.

stimulus_duration.evidence_note: Reported directly for the pink-noise samples.

renderer_or_apparatus.value: Two hidden loudspeakers mounted on the table, near about 5 cm from right hand and far about 100 cm from near loudspeaker.
renderer_or_apparatus.evidence_note: Toolkit profile preserves this as apparatus provenance and renders an equivalent generated trajectory.

auditory_conditions.value: IN approaching and OUT receding pink-noise conditions.
auditory_conditions.page_or_section: Measuring PPS representation and Figure 6 caption
auditory_conditions.evidence_note: The paper describes approaching and receding sounds and maps T1-T5 to D1-D5 differently for IN and OUT.

source_provenance.value: Pink-noise samples reported; exact original waveform, seed, and gain files are not supplied.
source_provenance.evidence_note: Toolkit validation uses generated pink-noise assets and retains source-equivalence as a caveat.

gain_envelope.value: Exact gain/envelope files or transfer functions are not reported.
gain_envelope.evidence_note: The physical two-speaker apparent-motion apparatus is reported, but not the author-side gain curve.

stimulus_speed.value: No metric speed is reported for the apparent two-loudspeaker motion; timing is represented by 3000 ms duration and T1-T5 delays.
stimulus_speed.evidence_note: The profile stores near/far apparatus provenance and timing rather than a source-speed claim.

trajectory_count.value: Two apparent-motion trajectories: IN and OUT.
trajectory_count.page_or_section: Measuring PPS representation and Figure 6 caption
trajectory_count.evidence_note: Both directions are materialized as sequence variants.

trial_rows_families.value: Audio-tactile target trials and auditory-only catch trials.
trial_rows_families.evidence_note: The paper states tactile stimulation occurred in 77% of trials and the remaining trials were auditory-only catches.

response_window.value: Vocal response as fast as possible to tactile target, ignore concurrent sounds; voice-activated relays recorded RTs.
response_window.evidence_note: Runner validation emulates this with mouse-click responses after tactile onset and catch withholds.

blocked_or_random_order.value: Each interleaved assessment session consisted of one block of the audio-tactile interaction task.
blocked_or_random_order.evidence_note: The training-day phase schedule is not encoded as a runner block because the profile target is the measurement task.

condition_intermixing.value: Audio-tactile target rows and auditory-only catches were intermingled in the assessment task.
condition_intermixing.evidence_note: The paper states tactile stimulation occurred in 77% of trials and remaining trials were catches.

iti_jitter_policy.value: Exact assessment-task ITI or jitter policy is not reported in the reviewed publisher HTML.
iti_jitter_policy.evidence_note: Routine ITI/randomization is handled by toolkit defaults and is not a profile blocker.

task_sequence_rules.value: Respond only to tactile targets and withhold responses on auditory-only catches.
task_sequence_rules.evidence_note: This is encoded as target rows with mouse-click responses and catch rows with response withholding.

tactile_stimulus.value: DS7A Digitimer constant-current electrical stimulator with Neuroline/Ambu electrodes on the participant's right hand.
tactile_stimulus.evidence_note: Participant-level current threshold table was not reported and is retained as an apparatus caveat.

soa_table.value: T1-T5 delays 300, 800, 1500, 2200, and 2700 ms from auditory onset for both IN and OUT sounds.
soa_table.page_or_section: Figure 6 caption and Measuring PPS representation
soa_table.evidence_note: D1-D5 distance labels are derived from the IN/OUT temporal correspondence described in the paper.

baseline_strategy.value: No tactile-only baseline rows are reported for this measurement block.
baseline_strategy.evidence_note: The profile sets baseline count to zero.

catch_trial_type.value: Auditory-only no-tactile catch trials requiring response withholding.
catch_trial_type.evidence_note: Exact catch count is derived because only the 77% tactile-target rate is printed.

baseline_timing.value: No tactile-only baseline timing is reported because no tactile-only baseline rows are part of the measurement block.
baseline_timing.evidence_note: The profile sets baseline rows to zero.

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.value: 8 repetitions per T1-T5 x IN/OUT cell, yielding 80 tactile-target rows.
repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.source_file: Frontiers HTML plus Canzoneri-family encoded protocol lineage
repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.page_or_section: The article states the task was used as in Canzoneri et al. (2013a) and Teneggi et al. (2013); the current toolkit Canzoneri-family profile encodes the 8-repetition structure.
repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.evidence_note: The exact repetition sentence is not printed in the Frontiers paper; it is inherited for the parsimonious runnable measurement profile.

catch_count.evidence_note: 80 target rows plus 24 catch rows gives 80/104 = 76.9%, matching the reported 77% tactile-target rate.

total_trial_count.evidence_note: 80 target rows plus 24 auditory-only catches in one assessment block.

baseline_count.evidence_note: No tactile-only baseline rows are reported for the PPS assessment block.

expected_outcome.primary_expected_effect: Synchronous tactile-hand and far-auditory training extends hand PPS without tool use; asynchronous stimulation does not produce the same extension.
expected_outcome.observable_metric: RT-by-distance curve and sigmoid central point before versus after synchronous/asynchronous training
expected_outcome.software_validation_boundary: The runner validation checks source-derived task parameters and participant-like response plumbing, not human PPS plasticity.

review_attempts.result: Consensus MCP search was attempted first but returned OAuth authorization required in this thread.
Frontiers HTML supplied the PPS measurement task source, apparatus, timing, response, catch, and training-context parameters.
Confirmed 3000 ms sounds and T1-T5 tactile delays of 300, 800, 1500, 2200, and 2700 ms.
The paper reports 77% tactile-target trials; the profile derives 24 catches from the inherited 80-target Canzoneri-family measurement structure.
The paper-specific validator generated a 104-row runnable package and mouse-click simulated target responses with catch withholds.
